content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD beach_2d simple case: plots mean-current vectors over significant wave height. Loads eta_00001 from fdir='../input_files/output/' (L2-L4) only to get the grid size (L6); grid built with dx=dy=2.0 (L7-L10). Defines sponge-zone outline x_sponge=[0 100 100 0 0] (L12-L13) and wavemaker outline x_wavemaker=[150 160 160 150 150] (L14-L15). Figure sized 4x5 inches @L21-L23. For each file number in nfile=[1] (L18, label cell min={'200'} @L19): loads umean_/vmean_/Hsig_/mask_ fields (L30-L33), NaN-masks dry cells (L35-L37), pcolor of Hsig with caxis([-0. 1]) (L41-L44), quiver of every sk=8-th vector in white (L46-L47), draws the sponge (green dashed, L50) and wavemaker (white, L54) outlines with rotated text labels 'Sponge' @L51-L52 and 'Wavemaker' @L55-L56, axis labels L58-L62. Final print command commented out @L68.
entities: script; clear all @L1; variables: fdir @L2; eta @L4; n,m @L6; dx @L7; dy @L8; x @L9; y @L10; x_sponge @L12; y_sponge @L13; x_wavemaker @L14; y_wavemaker @L15; nfile @L18; min @L19 (cell); wid @L21; len @L22; num loop @L27; fnum @L29; u @L30; v @L31; ht @L32; mask @L33; sk @L46; h1 @L51; h2 @L55
calls: builtins: load, size, sprintf, set/gcf/clf, pcolor/shading/caxis/colorbar, quiver, plot, text, xlabel/ylabel
unresolved: quiver @L47 indexes the 1-D vectors x,y with 2-D subscripts (1:sk:end,1:sk:end) — for row/column vectors the second subscript degenerates, so the x/y arguments become subsampled vectors while u,v are subsampled 2-D arrays; relies on quiver's vector-input broadcasting

pcolor(x,y,ht) @L41 plots Hsig but the commented ylabel text @L63-L64 says '\eta (m)' and the commented print name @L68 references the inlet_shoal case — copied from another script; cell variable 'min' @L19 shadows the MATLAB builtin and its '200' label is unused (title commented @L45)
caxis([-0. 1]) @L43 uses negative zero as lower bound; dx/dy hardcoded 2.0 must match the case's input.txt
